name: Check a failed ESC guard read is retried
step: Check a failed ESC guard read is retried
rationale:
The ESC forward-programming tiles are gated by a guard that reads the FC
once. A timeout or bus error used to latch it shut until the menu was
reopened; it now retries after a backoff. That retry reaches neither a
build nor a package step, so it is pinned here.

The servo BUS tile had a guard of the same shape, covered here too until
MSP API 22.16 made a servo a servo: the PWM and BUS pages became one Servos
page, there is nothing left to gate on a bus output, and app/servo_bus_guard.lua
and its cases were removed.
